background: Former Colorado forward who played professionally overseas before a long assistant apprenticeship: Denver (2005-10, player development under George Karl), Cleveland (2010-14) and Dallas (2014-21 under Rick Carlisle, where he ran the defense). Orlando Magic head coach 2021-26 (189-221): rebuilt a 22-win team into a perennial top-3 defense and three straight playoff appearances (2024, 2025, 2026), all first-round exits, including blowing a 3-1 lead and a 24-point Game 6 home lead to Detroit in 2026. Fired May 4, 2026 ('time for a new perspective, a fresh voice' - Jeff Weltman) amid four straight bottom-10 offenses and reported friction with Paolo Banchero. Hired by the Pelicans on May 18, 2026 on a five-year deal by Joe Dumars, beating out Darvin Ham, Steve Hetzel and Rajon Rondo, to lead a 'cultural reset' around Zion Williamson, Trey Murphy, Herb Jones, Jeremiah Fears and Derik Queen. Identity: physical, paint-first drop defense with heavy ball pressure and length; slow, drive-and-kick/paint-heavy offense with low 3-point volume and strong offensive rebounding; culture and development strengths; weak late-game and offensive-adjustment reputation.

prior_head_coaching.notes: Three consecutive first-round playoff exits (2024 vs CLE in 7, 2025 vs BOS 1-4, 2026 vs DET in 7 after leading 3-1). Top-3 defenses 2023-25; offense bottom-10 in each of his last four seasons.
